summary: @btopro interesting that you point #OER out... That is what drew me to microformats... Half the "open" repositories weren't explicit about how resources got parsed and the learning vocab for schema.org got so big time to just call it words.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @btopro interesting that you point #OER out... That is what drew me to microformats... Half the "open" repositories weren't explicit about how resources got parsed and the learning vocab for schema.org got so big time to just call it words.
